relations: River 是她哥哥；父亲多年来向 River 谎称她精神不稳定，River 曾是唯一善待她的家人。
四人因命运纠缠结成一个家庭。
Dante 是她的 mate，叫她 Angel，她叫他 Inferno。

facts.fact: Jazz 当面说：越狱以来 River 几乎没睡，一直设法自己复刻监狱魔法让她自由。
facts.anchor: But River has hardly slept since we made it out of the prison.

facts.fact: 父亲多年来谎称她精神不稳定；悔恨折磨 River 一个世纪；她轻声答 I can try。
facts.anchor: Your dad had been lying to him, claiming that you were mentally unstable, for years before you told him what was going on.

facts.fact: 四人留餐厅到晚饭、在多条布餐巾上画草图；回程她自认 Wrecked、这将是个长夜。
facts.anchor: All four of us had ended up staying in the restaurant through dinner, with diagrams sketched over multiple fabric napkins.

facts.fact: Dante 把车驶进一家她没去过的 Werewolf Café 得来速买咖啡，说今晚想做完计划就陪她做完。
facts.anchor: he pulled into the drive-through of a Werewolf Café location I'd never been to before.

facts.fact: Dante 劝她放下自责：我从没这么不无聊、这么满足过——血与性皆是。
facts.anchor: I've never been less bored, or more satisfied. Both blood-wise, and sexually.

facts.fact: 到家二十分钟后工作室里音乐大作，她画全新地图：与 River 在上半层光暗共织、不再需要电梯。
facts.anchor: River and I were going to weave light and dark power together in the upper half of the prison

facts.fact: Dante 凌晨 3 AM 左右脸贴键盘睡着，她垫毯子；5 点画完草图拖他上床。
facts.anchor: Dante dozed off with his face literally on the keyboard around 3 AM.

facts.fact: 半睡的他摸到她双翼两侧的疤追问；她首次吐露：父亲断续用铁链锁她的翅膀、留铁圈提醒随时能锁。
facts.anchor: My dad chained me there on and off, over the years. Just chained my wings together.
